subject: [PATCH v5 4/8] mm/gup: split out folio grab-and-store helper

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch splits the second part of the follow_page_pte function into a new helper called gup_grab_fill_folio_pages. This new function grabs a folio reference, marks it accessed and dirty if necessary, and stores the pages for the caller. The original function is simplified to only perform per-PTE safety checks. The cache flushes are moved to the caller's responsibility in __get_user_pages.
